answer: Because your ex is still on the title, they have to sign the sale documents like any co-owner. If they can't come to the appointment, they can sign power of attorney form NW-POA-2, which can be signed electronically with no notary (in Georgia it must be notarized). If the title joins your names with 'or' instead of 'and', only one owner has to sign. If your divorce decree awards the car to you, bring a certified copy of it and your ex doesn't need to sign at all. Because your name changed, also bring the divorce decree or court order that shows the change and your photo ID, and you'll sign the name change affidavit, form NW-NMC-1, at the appointment.
